title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Source defines conservative compressible variables, equation-of-state helpers, inviscid and viscous paths.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, geometry, adjacency, and boundary-family handling are present in submitted source.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp assembles residuals with global reductions, but delivered numerical outcomes fail.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Approximate Riemann-flux code is present; failed M0.8/M2 results do not support robust production behavior.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Dedicated boundary module implements farfield/slip/no-slip treatment in source.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares primitive gradients and linear face reconstruction are invoked in source.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen limiting and positivity-oriented reconstruction checks are identifiable in source.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous source exists, but all delivered laminar outputs fail/non-finite and no credible viscous case is complete.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady loop uses one frozen-RHS LU-SGS sweep per step; the terminal response identifies the scalar-Jacobian solver as unable to meet the required residual reduction.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: run_transient has a BDF2 outer/inner structure, but no Re200 final package or production convergence evidence exists; Re200 was not rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS k-way and neighbor-scoped halo implementation are present; no successful np=8 NACA/cylinder evidence was delivered.

disqualification_flags.evidence: See the explicit trigger-7 finding in the top-level disqualification assessment.
